options.content: ${cdn_filter}

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  hdx_cdn as cdn, 
  count(*) AS Total
FROM ${table} 
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  AND IF(position('${filter:raw}', 'hdx_cdn') = 0 OR length(trim('${filter:raw}')) = 0, hdx_cdn = '${cdn_default}', 1=1)
GROUP BY cdn

SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Offload by Hostname; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT
    (SUM(cache_hit) / (SUM(cache_hit) + SUM(cache_miss))) AS total
FROM 
(
    SELECT 
        countMergeIf(`count()`, cache_was_cached = 1) AS cache_hit,
        countMergeIf(`count()`, cache_was_cached = 0) as cache_miss
    FROM 
        ${table}
    WHERE 
        $__timeFilter(timestamp)
        AND $__adHocFilter()
        AND IF(position('${filter:raw}', 'hdx_cdn') = 0 OR length(trim('${filter:raw}')) = 0, hdx_cdn = '${cdn_default}', 1=1)
)

SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Akamai Cache Hit Total %; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT 
  sum(cache_was_cached) / cnt_all AS cache_hit_rate,
  timestamp AS time,
  hdx_cdn
FROM ${table}
WHERE 
  $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  AND IF(position('${filter:raw}', 'hdx_cdn') = 0 OR length(trim('${filter:raw}')) = 0, hdx_cdn = '${cdn_default}', 1=1)
GROUP BY time, hdx_cdn
ORDER BY time

SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Offload by Hostname; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT 
    timestamp AS time,
    (CASE WHEN cache_was_cached = 1 THEN response_total_bytes ELSE 0 END * 8) /${seconds} AS cache_throughput_bps,
    hdx_cdn
FROM 
    ${table}
WHERE 
    $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  AND IF(position('${filter:raw}', 'hdx_cdn') = 0 OR length(trim('${filter:raw}')) = 0, hdx_cdn = '${cdn_default}', 1=1)
GROUP BY time, hdx_cdn, cache_was_cached
ORDER BY time

SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Offload by Hostname; du=${__user.login}'
